- 下单链路仍是：
  - `PaperCycleOrchestrator._run_cycle()` -> `ExecutionGatekeeperService.submit_order()` at [services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py:919) and [services/execution/gatekeeper.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/gatekeeper.py:103)
  - 若走 Binance Simulation/Testnet，再到 `PaperExchangeExecutionService.ensure_binance_execution()` at [services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py:660)
  - 然后调 `BinanceUsdtPerpetualGateway.submit_order()` at [services/execution/gateway.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/gateway.py:337)
  - 本地 fill/开平仓由 `services.execution.paper_order_lifecycle.PaperOrderLifecycleService` at [services/execution/paper_order_lifecycle.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_order_lifecycle.py:50)

**已接上的新机制**
- `ConfigSnapshotRepository.activate_pending()` 在每个 cycle 开头生效，`PaperCycleOrchestrator` 也会从 active snapshot 覆盖 `paper_run.execution_profile` 和 `strategy.rules`。
  - 见 `services.strategy_library.repository.ConfigSnapshotRepository.activate_pending()` at [services/strategy_library/repository.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/strategy_library/repository.py:1116)
  - 运行时读取点在 [services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py:107)
- `gateway.submit_order()` 已支持新 contract 分支：若 `ExecutionOrderRequest.trade_intent` 和 `market_rules_snapshot` 存在，会走 `services.execution.order_normalizer.OrderNormalizer.normalize()`。
  - 见 [services/execution/gateway.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/gateway.py:338)
- `DecisionEventRepository`、`ConfigSnapshotRepository`、`TradeIntent`、`NormalizedOrder`、`ExecutionStateMachine` 都有模型/仓储/测试。
  - `shared.models.trading.TradeIntent` at [shared/models/trading.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/shared/models/trading.py:186)
  - `shared.models.trading.DecisionEvent` at [shared/models/trading.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/shared/models/trading.py:252)
  - `services.execution.state_machine.ExecutionStateMachine` at [services/execution/state_machine.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/state_machine.py:86)
  - `services.execution.decision_engine.DecisionEngine.build_intent()` at [services/execution/decision_engine.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/decision_engine.py:21)

**核心断点**
1. `TradeIntent -> NormalizedOrder` 没进入自动 Paper/Testnet 主路径。
- `ExecutionOrderRequest` 虽然有 `trade_intent` / `market_rules_snapshot` / `confirmed_position_quantity` 字段，定义在 [shared/models/workflow.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/shared/models/workflow.py:370)
- 但 `PaperCycleOrchestrator` 构造和提交的仍是旧式 `ExecutionOrderRequest`，依赖 `entry_context`，没有看到任何主路径给 `trade_intent` 赋值。
- `DecisionEngine.build_intent()` 在仓库里没有被 Paper/Testnet/Live 路径调用；`rg` 结果只见定义和测试。
- 结果：`gateway.submit_order()` 的 normalizer 分支存在，但自动运行时几乎不会进入。

2. `OrderExecution` 的新字段没有在 gatekeeper 入口被持续填充。
- `OrderExecution` 已有 `intent_id/cycle_id/decision_id/config_snapshot_id/config_hash/normalized_order`，定义在 [shared/models/workflow.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/shared/models/workflow.py:464)
- 但 `ExecutionGatekeeperService.submit_order()` 创建 `OrderExecution` 时，只从旧 `ExecutionOrderRequest` 复制基础字段；没有从 active config snapshot 自动注入 `config_snapshot_id/config_hash`，也不会从 `trade_intent` 衍生 `intent_id/decision_id/cycle_id/normalized_order`。
- 见 [services/execution/gatekeeper.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/gatekeeper.py:156)
- 所以即使 DB schema 支持，自动下单链上的订单记录仍可能是“空 intent / 空 snapshot / 空 normalized_order”。

3. `DecisionEvent` API 已有，但运行时基本不产出真实事件。
- API 在 `apps.api.routers.runs.list_paper_decision_events()`，见 [apps/api/routers/runs.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/apps/api/routers/runs.py:837)
- 仓库 append 在 `services.strategy_library.repository.DecisionEventRepository.append()`，见 [services/strategy_library/repository.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/strategy_library/repository.py:1412)
- 但自动 Paper/Testnet 主路径没有调用它。运行时仍在写旧 `DecisionSnapshotRepository.create_snapshot()`，见 [services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_cycle_orchestrator.py:1172)

- 结果：`/paper-runs/{id}/decision-events` 已暴露 timeline，但生产路径没有事件流，API 目前更多是“空壳”。

4. config snapshot 仍不是唯一事实源，兼容 API 还在先改旧状态、再补 snapshot。
- `PATCH /paper-runs/{id}/execution-profile` 先直接改 `PaperRun.execution_profile`，然后再创建 compat snapshot，见 [apps/api/routers/runs.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/apps/api/routers/runs.py:880)
- `PATCH /paper-runs/{id}/auto-settings` 同样先改 `RiskProfile` / `Strategy.rules` / `PaperRun.execution_profile`，再补 snapshot，见 [apps/api/routers/runs.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/apps/api/routers/runs.py:913)
- 这意味着 snapshot 已被 cycle 读取，但写路径仍是“双写兼容”，不是“snapshot-first”。如果中间失败，旧行和 snapshot 可能再漂移。

5. 恢复 API 还是旧 `execution_status` 体检，不是基于新状态机/事件流。
- `/recovery-check` 在 [apps/api/routers/runs.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/apps/api/routers/runs.py:1380)
- 它只扫描 `OrderExecution.execution_status`、`stoploss_present`、`reconciliation_status`
- 不读 `DecisionEvent`
- 不读 `ExecutionStateMachine`
- 不读 `trade_intent/normalized_order/market_rules_snapshot`
- 不生成 recovery plan，只返回 blockers
- 这和 ADR-060 想要的“controlled lifecycle + recovery semantics”还有明显距离。

6. `ExecutionStateMachine` / `BinanceUserDataReducer` 仍未接入持久化恢复闭环。
- reducer 在 `services.execution.binance_user_stream.BinanceUserDataReducer.apply()`，见 [services/execution/binance_user_stream.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/binance_user_stream.py:27)
- state machine 在 [services/execution/state_machine.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/state_machine.py:86)
- 但没有看到任何 Paper/Testnet/Live 路径把 user-stream event 落到 `DecisionEvent` 或 `OrderExecution.normalized_order/lifecycle`，也没有恢复时重放它们。
- 当前 `get_order_timeline()` 只是把 `OrderExecution.lifecycle_history` 原样返回，见 [apps/api/routers/runs.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/apps/api/routers/runs.py:1360)

**关于 recovery / 持久化现状**
- 已有的 exchange-truth 恢复只覆盖“仓位是否还在、保护单是否缺失、是否需要重建/取消”，集中在 `PaperExchangeExecutionService.reconcile_local_positions_with_exchange()`。
  - 见 [services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py:475)
- 这条链能恢复 `PositionSnapshot`，也会回写 `OrderExecution.gateway_status/lifecycle_history`
- 但它恢复的是“旧纸面状态”，不是“新 intent/order state”。
- 换句话说：仓位真相恢复已经存在，contract-level 执行真相恢复还没接上。

**最小、可测试的实现顺序**
1. 先把自动 Paper 开单入口接到 `TradeIntent`，不改 close/reconcile。
- 在 `services.execution.paper_cycle_orchestrator.PaperCycleOrchestrator` 的开仓路径，基于 active config snapshot + signal 决策，调用 `services.execution.decision_engine.DecisionEngine.build_intent()`
- 然后把生成的 `trade_intent/config_snapshot_id/config_hash` 放进 `ExecutionOrderRequest`
- 这样最小影响面只在 entry path，且能立刻覆盖 `gateway.submit_order()` 的 normalized 分支

2. 再让 `ExecutionGatekeeperService.submit_order()` 成为新字段的稳定持久化边界。
- 若 request 携带 `trade_intent`，则持久化 `intent_id/cycle_id/decision_id/config_snapshot_id/config_hash`
- 若 normalizer 已跑，则把 `normalized_order` 写进 `OrderExecution`
- 这一步可单测 `OrderExecution` 持久化，不需要碰 Binance

3. 再在自动 Paper/Testnet 主路径上 append 最少量 `DecisionEvent`。
- 至少先落三类：
  - `TRADE_INTENT_CREATED`
  - `BLOCKED`
  - `ORDER_SUBMITTED`
- 这三类就足够替代当前大部分 `DecisionSnapshot` 诊断用途，并让 `/decision-events` API 有真实数据
- 顺序上不建议一开始就覆盖所有 event type

4. 再把 `recovery-check` 从旧字符串体检升级为“event/state aware”。
- 先读 `OrderExecution.intent_id/normalized_order/config_snapshot_id`
- 再引入 `ExecutionStateMachine` 对 lifecycle/event 做恢复判定
- 最后才把 user-stream reducer 接入持久化
- 这样能先做离线恢复判断，再接实时事件

5. 最后才迁移 close/protection/reconcile 到同一 contract 语义。
- 这里最复杂，因为 `PaperExchangeExecutionService.gateway_order_request()` 仍在靠 `entry_context.close_only_mode/reduce_only/quantity`
- 见 [services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py](/C:/Users/win/Desktop/AI--main/services/execution/paper_exchange_execution.py:60)
- close path 还需要 `confirmed_position_quantity`、hedge/one-way 语义统一，适合放最后

如果需要，我可以下一轮把这些断点整理成“可直接执行的迁移清单”，按文件和测试点拆成更细的任务。"}}]}
